stem.text: A vertically polarised beam of light of intensity $I_0$ is incident normally on a polarising filter.

The transmission axis of the filter is at $45^{\circ}$ to the vertical. The beam of light transmitted by this filter is then incident normally on a second filter. The transmission axis of the second filter is horizontal.

stem.alt: Diagram of a light beam passing from left to right through two square filters drawn as tilted grey squares. Labels: vertically polarised light, I_0, 45°, transmission axis of first filter, transmission axis of second filter.

stem.text: What is the intensity of the beam of light after transmission through the second filter?
